configuration: Thermo Scientific 1300 Series Class II, Type A2, catalog 1305. Four-foot 120 V cabinet with a one-piece stainless interior and an 8-inch working opening. Cabinet only, with the standard task lamp and rear-wall receptacles. The optional stand, armrests, UV lamp, service valves and exhaust thimble are omitted.

views.title: Operator side
views.alt: Original model rendering of the cabinet enclosure and operator opening.
views.caption: The front and oblique photographs place the projecting canopy above the blue window rails. The stainless deck lies between the front intake grille and the perforated strip at the back. The catalog photographs show a cabinet without a stand.
views.revision: Catalog 1305, listing 0870VV BIO CAB; unit release unreported

views.title: Work chamber and loading opening
views.alt: Original loading-area rendering of the sealed specimen on the steel tray, with an accessory outlet on the rear wall.
views.caption: The exact-model gallery shows the continuous steel tray, grilles and the rear-wall receptacles. Figure 1-4 distinguishes the fully raised loading opening from the working position. The sealed specimen in the render belongs to the virtual session.
views.revision: Catalog 1305, listing 0870VV BIO CAB; unit release unreported

views.title: Control panel
views.alt: Original model rendering of the right-hand membrane controls.
views.caption: The brochure close-up shows the display at left and the key and indicator banks at right. The manual photographs identify the sash-position indicator and its green working-position response.

additionalSources.label: Manual, sash and indicator photographs, figs. 1-5–1-8

views.title: Side and top interfaces
views.alt: Original model rendering showing the cabinet interfaces.
views.caption: The manual locates the cord, serial connection and fuse holders on top. Its oblique drawing and the right-side photograph locate the wall penetrations relative to the sloping front. The accessory outlet callout points into the chamber.

views.title: Rear counterweight
views.alt: Original model rendering of the rear face and sash counterweight.
views.caption: The manufacturer’s rear three-quarter drawing identifies the counterweight between two vertical side rails. The panel outline and guides can be compared visually. The drawing gives no counterweight mass or dimensions.

limits: The equipment register establishes the 1300 A2 family. Catalog 1305 and the Rev. 20 dimensions specify this reconstruction. The institutional inventory does not identify its six individual units by catalog number.

Small enclosure profiles, sash-glass thickness, switch internals, cable routing and counterweight geometry are inferred. No survey, manufacturer CAD, serial-specific rear photograph or dimensioned internal assembly drawing was available.

The illustrated manual and commercial catalog remain at their original links. All renderings on this sheet are original views of the downloadable model. The source images establish component placement and proportions; they provide no independent experimental measurement of the simulated warning.
